question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Discipline must be ________ at any cost
solution:
The solution is **maintained**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank in "Discipline must be ________ at any cost" is maintained.
 
• Discipline must be maintained at any cost.
 
• Therefore **option 3 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about other options:

 
 
• ​**Instructed - **Tell or order someone to do something, especially in a formal or official way.

 
 
• **​***For example *:* "I instructed that she should be given hot tea."*
 
 
 
• **Curtailed - **Reduce in extent or quantity, impose a restriction on.
 
 
• **​***For example : "Civil liberties were further curtailed."*
 
 
 
• **Highlighted - **Draw special attention to.
 
 
• **​***For example : "Her mental issue was highlighted."*
